BrochureContent.Content:
This property comprises an attractive site extending to approximately 0.94 acres, offering a wonderful opportunity to construct a family home in a peaceful countryside setting.

The property benefits from Full Planning Permission with no local occupancy restrictions, allowing the purchaser to proceed with the approved development regardless of their place of residence or local connection.

The site offers panoramic countryside views with permission to build a detached house comprising of entrance porch, entrance hall, living room, kitchen/dining room, utility, three bedrooms (two en-suites), hotpress and a family bathroom. The floor area is to extend to 156.63 sq m/1685.34 sq ft. There is also a mains water connection available to the site. 

Bohaun South is a rural location approximately 6.5 kilometers southwest of Killawalla, a small village with a church, public house and shop. 

The closest town is Westport which is approximately a 20 minute drive away. A popular charming town with most amenities such as supermarkets, bars, restaurants and much more. 

Special Features
• 0.94 acre site
• Mains water available to the site
• Full Planning Permission
• No local occupancy restrictions
• Countryside views
• 20 minutes drive from Westport
